headline: A small S321 write-back gap was recovered, and route provenance gained a CI-reachable corroborating vantage without weakening the production gate.

items.title: Content promotion's release guard now has a CI-reachable corroborating signal
items.insight: Production is bot-challenged for datacenter clients, so the primary worker-route-provenance receipt can only come from a locally-run probe. build-worker-route-provenance.mjs --probe now also probes the staging workers_dev origin and writes an additive buildVantage field, picked up automatically by CI's existing hourly --probe step. check-content-capability-slice.mjs was read before writing any code and still requires observedOrigin === production verbatim, so a build attestation can never satisfy the split-release guard.
items.evidence: build-worker-route-provenance self-test 19/19 (6 new) · check-content-capability-slice self-test unchanged 7/7 · build:check 319/319

items.title: A post-closeout commit from S321 was documented, not redone
items.insight: Write-back-currency triage (F7) found a commit that landed 15h after S321's closeout wrote back its state surfaces, wiring two self-tests into check-proof-surface after check-orphan-scripts correctly flagged the new script as unreferenced. The code was already shipped and pushed, so this session recorded the closure (D-S321.3) instead of re-implementing it.

followUps: [S321][SIL][GATE/P1] Audit remaining gate names against what they actually assert — carried forward, not picked up this session.
Production-route half of route-provenance vantage still depends on a locally-run probe; content promotion is unblocked, not automated.
blockers: real-provider-e2e-pending: one founder passkey ceremony (CANON-019 founder-reserved).
